headline: Washburn end Pittsburg State's unbeaten start
dek: Pittsburg State had won fifteen and drawn five before meeting Washburn. That first defeat leaves Dallas Baptist and Nova Southeastern as the only programmes in the division still without a loss.
displaced_by: headline stands on a quiet day; dek's 'before last night' no longer names the 2026-11-08 match, so only that phrase is reworded
